## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `095128f4851519b0d8da96f4228d6266e2dfcac1`

Reviewed read-only: card objectui#10645 (body and all 7 comments, including triage `5835062094`, claim `5835159185` and amended claim `5835856266`), PR objectui#10677 (body, file list, check-runs), the head fetched into `refs/review/pr-10677`, main into `refs/review/main`, objectui `AGENTS.md` §测试纪律 and §版本号策略, `.changeset/config.json`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, and the source the test consumes (`apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `apps/console/src/registerDeveloperComponents.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/ComponentNavView.tsx`, `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`). Merge-base `4758b33c2bae14dadfd86b3096a196fcc8e91d69`. Zero GitHub writes. The `os-dev-report` comment (`5835829964`) was not used as evidence; every claim below is checked against the diff or the source at the head.

Diff surface (merge-base..head): 2 files. `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` (+44/-1) and `.changeset/10645-api-console-preset-lazy-route-readiness.md` (+4, new). No spec symbol is consumed by the change (the new import is `en` from in-repo `@object-ui/i18n`); `/home/user/objectui/node_modules` holds no `.pnpm` on this box, which is moot for that reason.

### ① Derived judgments

**Binding text.** Triage `5835062094`: 「Make readiness explicit (warm or await the lazy route, or resolve the boot's connection in the harness) rather than a bare timeout raise; a raise, if kept, says why. Check the sibling cases for the same shape. Test-only; ⛔ no retry wrapper, ⛔ no skip.」 Card direction: "resolve the boot's connection deterministically in the test harness, or await the boot to finish before the `findBy*`."

**1. `waitFor` added to the RTL import — test.tsx:41.** Right. Used at :315. RTL's re-export carries the act wrapper; the correct source.

**2. `import { en } from '@object-ui/i18n'` — test.tsx:125.** Right. The file's `vi.mock('@object-ui/i18n', …)` at :83-91 spreads `importOriginal()`, so `en` is the real catalogue. `LoadingScreen.tsx:6` imports the same `en` and renders `strings.initializing` at :105 via `getStartupStrings()` (:46-67), which returns `enLocale.console` when the resident pack is `en` (:59). The mock overrides only `useObjectTranslation` and `useObjectLabel`, and `LoadingScreen` deliberately uses neither (:19-23 comment). So the boot-frame string is bound BY REFERENCE to the value the screen renders: a copy change to `en.ts:1764` moves both sides together. Drift-proof.

**3. `LAZY_ROUTE_FRAMES = [en.console.initializing, 'Loading API console…']` — test.tsx:289.** Right, with one robustness note. The second entry is a hand-copied literal. Its source is `registerDeveloperComponents.tsx:49` (`DeveloperFallback` renders `Loading {label}…`, three adjacent text nodes that RTL's `getNodeText` joins to one string, which is why a literal `git grep` finds it only in the test) and :57 (`label="API console"`). Nothing committed pins the literal to that source: a copy change there (say `API Console`) makes the second leg vacuously true and the test stays green, because the helper asserts absence only. That is not a weakened guard (the merge-base had no such wait at all) and the `findBy` that follows still fails if the page never mounts, so it cannot yield a false pass; it is the one string in the fix that can drift without the test noticing, and I record it as such.

**4. `LAZY_ROUTE_BOUND_MS = 10_000` — test.tsx:297, doc :291-296.** Right. `vitest.config.mts:287` sets `testTimeout: 15000`, so the bound sits under it as the doc says; the `findBy` default (1000 ms) is untouched at :328 and :342. The doc states why the bound exists (cold lazy on a saturated shard, objectui#10645), which satisfies the triage's "a raise, if kept, says why" for the only bound the diff introduces. The doc's claim that a miss "fails here with the DOM printed" is true: RTL's `waitFor` default `onTimeout` runs the last error through `getElementError`, which appends the pretty-printed container.

**5. `lazyRouteSettled()` — test.tsx:314-321; called at :326 and :340.** Judged against the brief's three questions:

- *Explicit readiness or a timeout raise in disguise?* Explicit readiness. The predicate names the two concrete frames the console shows while a lazy on the route pends, and both are the real frames: app-shell `console/AppContent.tsx:1053` wraps the route table (the `component/:ns/:name/*` route at :1110 and `{extraRoutes}` at :1122) in `Suspense` with `LoadingScreen` as fallback; `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx:218` wraps the standalone `ApiConsolePage` lazy (:25) in `Suspense` with `LoadingScreen`; `registerDeveloperComponents.tsx:57-58` wraps the registry lazy (:35) with `DeveloperFallback label="API console"`. This is the triage's "await the lazy route" option. It is still a bounded wait, as any wait must be, and the PR body says so in its "Honest limit" paragraph; that is not a bare raise on the `findBy`.

- *Can the absence wait pass vacuously before either frame appears?* Not on the paths in scope, and never to a false green. RTL's `render` is act-wrapped, so by the time `lazyRouteSettled()` first runs, the first commit is already in the DOM. On that commit the tree holds either (i) `LoadingScreen` from app-shell's pre-route readiness gates (`console/AppContent.tsx:732`, :760), (ii) `LoadingScreen` from a suspended route `Suspense` (:1053, or `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx:218`), (iii) the page itself when every lazy is already resolved (the warm registry-key row, which runs second in file order), or (iv) some unrelated frame only if the harness is broken, in which case the unchanged `findByPlaceholderText` fails loudly. Hand-off from an outer boundary's fallback to an inner boundary's fallback (ComponentNavView resolving, then the registry lazy suspending) is one React commit, so there is no tick with neither frame and no page. Therefore for the cold cases the wait does move the cold import plus React's first-suspension reveal out of the 1000 ms `findBy` window and under the 10 s bound; for the warm case it passes on its first check, which is the correct reading of "already ready". The failure window genuinely changes.

- *Does it rest on a string that could drift?* One of two: see item 3. The boot text cannot drift; the registry fallback literal can.

**6. The three call sites — test.tsx:326 (tool-preview), :340 (the `it.each` covering the registry key and the standalone route).** Right against "Check the sibling cases for the same shape." The tool-preview case routes through `component/developer/api-console`, which pays app-shell's lazy `ComponentNavView` (`console/AppContent.tsx:59`) and then the registry's own lazy: the same shape, arguably more exposed. The registry-key row shares the `it.each` body with the standalone route, so it takes the same wait. The harness control at :346-351 renders no lazy (root catch-all) and is correctly left alone.

**7. Existing pins edited or deleted.** None. The single `-` line is the import line gaining `waitFor`. Every existing `expect` at :328-332 and :342-343 is byte-identical to the merge-base. No guard weakened.

**8. New pins: lit control and negative leg.** The helper is a readiness wait, not a behavioural pin, and the committed file carries no lit control for it (nothing asserts either frame ever appears). It can fail: a frame persisting past 10 s trips `waitFor` with the DOM printed. Its only false direction is vacuity (item 5), which the unchanged `findBy` closes. The negative legs of the file's actual pins are unchanged. The PR's ablation evidence (A1/A2) comes from an uncommitted harness and is not verifiable from the diff.

**9. Asked and missing.** Nothing. Readiness made explicit: yes. Bound explained: yes. Siblings checked: yes. Test-only: yes. No retry wrapper: none (no `retry`, no `vi.retry`, no test-level `{ retry }`). No skip: none. The card's "resolve the boot's connection in the harness" leg is already satisfied at the merge-base: `dataSourceStub.getConnectionState` returns `'connected'` at :101-104, so there is no connection to resolve; the CI DOM dump's "Connecting to data source" is `LoadingScreen`'s first step label (`LoadingScreen.tsx:74`), shown by a `Suspense` fallback, not by a real connection wait.

**10. Done and not asked.** Only the changeset, which the gate demands (② below) and which the amended claim `5835856266` adds to the file surface. Nothing else.

**11. AGENTS.md §测试纪律 on `beforeAll`.** The PR's citation holds. AGENTS.md:257 reads 「**不要用 `beforeAll` 预热**:它受 `hookTimeout`(**10s**)约束,比它取代的 `testTimeout`(**15s**)**更窄**,那只是把问题挪个窝。」 So rejecting the thread's option (a) (`5834633229`'s `beforeAll` warm-up) in favour of the triage's "await the lazy route" option is the repo rule, not a preference. Also relevant: the section's primary prescription (module-scope import, :256) was already applied at the merge-base (test.tsx:127-130) and did not prevent the CI failures the card lists, because a lazy's first render still suspends; so the repo's first-line remedy was exhausted before this PR.

**12. Measurement sentences in the PR body** (timeline probe: lazy called +3.5 ms, settles +12.3 ms, page +350 ms; the slowed-import table at 900/1200/3000 ms; ablations A1/A2; the 10-run min/median/max table). Each comes from a harness the body itself says was "deleted, never committed" / "not committed". None is verifiable from the diff or reproducible here; each is worded as the author's own measurement and the body discloses the harness's absence, so none is a false statement about the diff. I treat them as unverified context, not as evidence for the verdict. The body's "react-dom 19.2.8" is verified by the lockfile at the head and `apps/console/package.json:111`; the `FALLBACK_THROTTLE_MS = 300` constant is react-dom internals outside this review's reading set and this box has no installed `node_modules`, so it is not verified here.

**13. PR body sentence "a copy of the pattern cannot silently drop a frame without going red under the harness below (the harness itself is not committed)".** True only under that uncommitted harness. In the committed tree, dropping or misspelling a frame is silent (item 3). The sentence's own parenthesis concedes this.

### ② Semver level

**Level: empty frontmatter (releases nothing). Correct.** The changeset at the head is exactly `---` immediately followed by `---`, a blank line, and one prose paragraph (467 bytes, verified with `cat -A`). `.changeset/config.json` names `@object-ui/console` in the `fixed` group (39 packages, one family), and `apps/console/package.json` is `@object-ui/console` at 17.6.0, not private, so any non-empty bump would carry the whole group; nothing published moves, so none is owed. AGENTS.md §版本号策略 forbids `major` in changesets; empty frontmatter satisfies it trivially. `check-changeset-no-major` and `Changeset Bump Policy` are green at the head.

**Does the gate really require it?** Yes, measured with the script itself, read-only via its `--base`/`--head` arguments:
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs --base 0c3f70aae71f026f6afee49422f31494b303880f --head a1d306497b971ee2ce23efe0dded9d3aac0e9879` (the test-only commit against its true merge-base; 1 file changed): exit 1, 「1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset: @object-ui/console apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx」.
- `… --base 4758b33c2bae14dadfd86b3096a196fcc8e91d69 --head 095128f4851519b0d8da96f4228d6266e2dfcac1` (the PR head against its merge-base): exit 0, 「Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing, which is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate.」
- The rule is in the script's own code and header: `isPublishedSource` (:751-756) returns true for anything under a fixed-group package's `src/` with no test exception, and the header states 「No carve-out for test files under `src/`. A change confined to `src/__tests__/` is answered by the empty-frontmatter exemption, in one line.」 The CI job `Changeset Declaration` (`.github/workflows/changeset-presence.yml:97`, :126 `run: node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`) is this script and is green at the head. Precedent on main: 585 of 2102 changesets have empty frontmatter, many with prose bodies (e.g. `.changeset/10176-formpage-retired-type-pin.md`, "Test-only in `@object-ui/console`…").
So the original claim's "no changeset owed (`apps/console` publishes nothing)" was wrong on the gate's terms, and the amended claim's correction is right. The PR body's Deviation section reports this accurately.

**Changeset prose, sentence by sentence:**
1. "Test-only change in `@object-ui/console`, no package released:" — true (diff is one test file plus this declaration; frontmatter empty).
2. "the route-table cases of `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` now wait for the API console's lazy route to leave its loading frames before their existing `findBy*`," — true (:326, :340 precede :328, :342). Precision note: three of the four route-table cases; the harness control renders no API-console lazy route, which the sentence's qualifier covers.
3. "instead of spending the default 1000 ms window on the module loader." — true; the 1000 ms default is preserved and now begins after the frames leave.
4. "The standalone `developer/api-console` case failed that window intermittently on a saturated CI shard (objectui#10645)." — true against the card's body (runs `36143553512`, `36142794712`) and `5835531189`.
5. "No published behaviour changes." — true (no source file changed).

No docs or README prose is added by the diff; the only added prose outside the changeset is code comments in the test, judged in ① items 4 and 5 (their description of the two `Suspense` fallbacks and of `ComponentNavView` being lazy is verified against `console/AppContent.tsx:59, :1053` and `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx:218`).

### ③ Boundary flags
